originalFinding.summary: Cascading-value subscription lookups rehash stable component property names.
originalFinding.explanation: ComponentSubscriptionKey is used by subscription dictionaries and is reconstructed for get, subscribe, and unsubscribe operations. HashCode.Combine hashes PropertyName on every lookup even though component property-name strings are stable metadata reused across operations. A prehashed/canonical property-name representation could avoid that repeated string hashing, but the benefit is unmeasured.
originalFinding.snippet:
public override int GetHashCode()
    => HashCode.Combine(Subscriber, PropertyName);

scope: Research and one throwaway metadata-prehash prototype; not an approved shipping implementation.
hypothesis: Compute the ordinal name hash once in existing per-type cascading metadata and carry that int in the subscription key. Prehashing a freshly constructed lookup key alone would not amortize anything.
prototype: Add only an internal cached PropertyNameHashCode to existing CascadingParameterInfo; compute it in its existing internal constructor.
ComponentSubscriptionKey keeps its existing subscriber/name equality, takes the existing in CascadingParameterInfo instead of a string, and hashes its cached name int.
Update only the dependent key constructions in CascadingParameterValueProvider and PersistentStateValueProvider. Preserve explanatory locals and branch structure.
Do not add a separate static cache, public API, IVT, UnsafeAccessor, new provider abstraction or altered lifetime.
acceptance: Run existing CascadingParameterTest, CascadingParameterStateTest and the three persistent-provider test classes on unchanged original and actual default before prototype edits; parse every individual XML result.

Use actual public TryAddCascadingValueSupplier registration and public HtmlRenderer: 64 retained child components, real reflection-produced cascading metadata, normal renderer-created subscriptions, changed direct Generation parameters and actual rendered HTML.
Never invoke a provider GetCurrentValue, subscription callback, framework render method or metadata-change event directly as producer-reachability proof.

Observe real subscription creation, every producer-owned GetCurrentValue call, retained component parameter values/HTML and actual renderer-driven unsubscribe/disposal; check exact counts, not merely nonzero.
Run RegisteredShort4, RegisteredLong4 and PlainShort4, each three untimed lifetime repetitions on original/default/candidate; same compiled C#13 harness in every image.

Use actual captured component/metadata inputs for additional direct key contract checks: equal different string references, ordinal case distinctions, different property/subscriber, default key and null-name default metadata. Distinguish those checks from render-producer proof.
Measure actual struct sizes, including the metadata, cascading-state and dictionary-key storage trade-offs; no claim that caching is free.
Preserve existing hash formula exactly within each process and all equality/disposal behavior. Existing focused tests also run on candidate and restored original if rejected.

Freeze source-built owners, complete consumer inventories, actual PE/PDB/source associations, common harness identity and protected files before timing. Only actual Components owner DLL/PDB may differ between original/candidate consumers.
Independently rebuild the exact common project and repeat untimed lifetime checks against the frozen owner images; no historical timing replay.
metadataRefresh: CascadingParameterState already owns the per-type metadata cache and subscribes to HotReloadManager.ClearCache. Retained ComponentState rebuilds parameter bindings/subscriptions on metadata update. The new derived name int is created with each replacement metadata record, not a new independent cache. Existing refresh tests are diagnostic regression coverage, not live-delta proof.

validationBoundary.owner: Actual CascadingParameterValueProvider/ComponentSubscriptionKey and persistent-provider keys in Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.
validationBoundary.producer: Public DI registration plus real HtmlRenderer component construction, reflected custom attributes and changed parent-to-child direct parameters.
validationBoundary.observable: Assigned cascading values, exact rendered HTML, exact get/subscribe/dispose counts and unchanged key equality/hash invariants.
validationBoundary.shippingFollowupIfQualified: Before retaining a shipping change, satisfy applicable sample/browser/permanent-test and architecture requirements and live-delta metadata validation. No performance qualification alone grants shipping readiness.
validationBoundary.exclusions: No browser/native DOM, Server/WASM/Auto, real Session/TempData I/O, persistence navigation, AOT/trimming, complete compiler-input provenance or whole-application performance claim.

benchmark.primary: RegisteredShort4: four 10/11-character property names, 64 retained components, one changed direct generation per parent tick.
benchmark.unchangedMatchedControl: PlainShort4: same public rendering/update shape and four ordinary CascadingParameter values through CascadingValueSource, without ComponentSubscriptionKey.
benchmark.primaryOperation: One synchronous parent tick delivering four cascading values to each of 64 retained children and completing their renders.
benchmark.timing: Stopwatch.GetTimestamp around the fixed synchronous dispatcher-owned loop; report raw elapsed ticks and per-parent-tick nanoseconds.
benchmark.allocations: GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread around that same synchronous loop; report raw bytes and B/parent-tick.
benchmark.machineSettings: No affinity, priority, power, firewall or machine-setting changes; shared-box limitations remain.
benchmark.qualification: Primary median less-time >=10%, faster in at least 2 of 3 completed pairs and greater than absolute same-pair matched-control movement in at least 2 pairs. Allocation-only qualification requires >=32 primary B/tick saved in at least 2 pairs with matched control savings at least32 B/tick smaller. No secondary-primary substitution.
benchmark.adverseGuard: No qualification if plain matched-control median slowdown>=10% in at least2 pairs, or equality, lifecycle, actual producer counts, original restoration or provenance checks fail.
